comments.author: Alysia
comments.body:
The step this quest :
1. Havana - Talk to barkeeper
2. Nassau - Talk to blackbeard
3. British isles south coast - Fight English Navy Near London
4. Lisbon open sea - Fight Portuguese Navy Near Lisbon
5. Strait of Gibraltar - Fight Spanish Navy Near Seville
6. Nassau - Talk to blackbeard
7. Antilles open sea - Fight Unknown Fleet Near Nassau
8. Nassau - Talk to blackbeard
* Blackbeard in Nassau is Creepy Man
After done this quest report and If u want change job be filibuster back to Nassau and Talk to Blackbeard (Creepy Man )

comments.author: Caddy
comments.body: So this quest indeed does require Pirate job to be completed. Tested with me pulling it and a fleetmate being unable to accept it with the message something to the effect of "quest is restricted by job" being displayed. The prerequisite quest though (Pirates known as 'fear') does not appear to be job restricted. Both are 10* quests though, so pulling them can be very difficult.
